en.html:
After an unnecessarily long delay, I finally reached the next station.

…How long since Muramasa was abducted?

No time to think. Nor did I want to.
I plunged into the station, looking neither left nor right.

Plenty of people—but no Sorimachi. No Muramasa.

Where?
Where had they gone from here?!

Muramasa.
Saying that name, I felt a deep loss.

She was not beside me.
The presence that had never left me for a moment was not here.

Though I wanted her here.
